title: Ontology and Validation Tree Viewer for Coda
description: Implement React tree viewer components for ontology visualization and validation result (data graph) visualization in the semio-coda desktop app. Add Storybook stories for both general ontology trees and specific validation report trees.
summary: Implemented OntologyTree and ValidationTree React components in renderer.tsx with full OWL class expression support. Added ClassAssertion to ValidationNodeKind. Created storybook stories for both: OntologyTree (NecessaryStaircaseInSeparateStairwell English ontology) and ValidationTree (Treppenraum_A validation report with full German instance data, plus incomplete data scenario with unknown truth values). Updated semio-elements storybook config with @semio/coda-desktop alias and coda stories glob. Storybook builds successfully.
